children: An address linked to early Ethereum contributor billΞ.eth withdrew 500,000 LIT from the Lighter protocol two hours ago, according to on-chain analyst Ai Yi. According to Odaily, Lighter is a perpetual DEX built into Robinhood Wallet, and its trading volume has recently increased. LIT has risen more than 97% over the past month.

title: Ethereum Early Contributor Withdraws 500,000 LIT From Lighter Protocol
